title: Lemony Arugula Salad with Avocado & Herbs
description: Peppery arugula with avocado, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and fresh herbs in a bright lemon-Dijon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: red onion or shallot, thinly sliced

instructions.text: Whisk together {7} olive oil, {8} lemon juice, {9} Dijon, {10} honey, {11} garlic, {12} salt, and {13} black pepper until combined.
Place {0} arugula, {1} cucumber, {2} cherry tomatoes, {4} red onion, {5} parsley, and {6} dill or basil in a large bowl.
Just before serving, add about three-quarters of the dressing and toss gently.
Add {3} avocado and toss very lightly so it stays intact. Add more dressing as needed.
Taste and adjust with an extra squeeze of lemon or more black pepper before serving.

notes: Dill is especially good here alongside crab cakes. Add a tablespoon of capers per serving if you want a briny note. Dress just before serving — arugula wilts quickly once dressed.
